overall: Complaint resolved by informal action with no violation found. The AG declined a broad review of budget briefings, found the March 25 one-member briefing was not deliberation, and declined the Mayor allegations as he is not a public body.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Mayor's budget briefings with Board subquorums could become serial deliberation by a quorum, and asked the AG to review the practice generally.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to do so because this office will not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a March 25 briefing of one Board member by the Mayor on the budget was deliberation that violated the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Because there was no communication between or among a quorum of the Board, we find there was no deliberation requiring a posted meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint's allegations against the Mayor individually under the Open Meeting Law, since the Mayor is not a member of a public body.
allegations.key_passage: The Mayor is an individual public official who is not a member of a public body, thus he is not subject to the Open Meeting Law.
